verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents that it is free to self-host with data staying entirely within your own infrastructure and can be fully air-gapped, which lets users choose exactly where their data lives (docs-27/56). However, there is no explicit mention of a managed/cloud offering with selectable regions or residency guarantees, so the 'choose region' capability is only implicit via self-hosting. Missing for 10: explicit region-selection UI/settings, documented data residency options for any hosted/cloud tier, and independent confirmation of deployment flexibility.
